title: Refunds and Fees Specialist Callbacks for Personal Sender Account Holders
content:
Paloma's refunds and fees specialists call back a Personal Sender Account holder who asks, on a support call, to go through the fees and refunds on their transfers. When the customer requests such a callback, it is booked with a fees callback window — a whole number of Paloma business days — that fixes the last business day by which the specialist will call.

## Booking condition

A callback on refunds and fees is not booked until the account history carries a statement request dated the day the callback is requested.

Restated: on a day when the account history shows no statement request dated that same day, a callback on refunds and fees is not yet booked; once a statement request dated that day stands on the account history, the callback can be booked that day.

## What a booked callback is

One call records one scheduled callback on the account history, dated today, on the topic refunds and fees, recorded as requested by phone, with its callback due date. Nothing else on the account, its level, its limits or its transfers changes. The customer can be told the callback reference number and the last business day by which the specialist will call.

## How it is invoked

The agent unlocks the tool `schedule_fees_callback_4571f432` (with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `sender_account_id` | the Personal Sender Account reference number of the customer to be called back, as returned by the Personal Sender Account lookup for this customer |
| `callback_window_business_days` | the callback window as a whole number of Paloma business days: an integer of 1 or more with no fractional part; the tool applies no rounding |

The callback due date recorded is the date, in YYYY-MM-DD form on Paloma's operations calendar (US Central Time), reached by counting `callback_window_business_days` Paloma business days (Monday to Friday, excluding US Federal Reserve holidays) forward from today's date, today not counted.

## Return

A successful call returns a text rendering of a dictionary with these fields:

- `account_event_id` — the reference number of the scheduled callback;
- `callback_topic` — always "refunds_and_fees";
- `request_date` — today's date, YYYY-MM-DD;
- `callback_due_date` — the last business day for the callback, YYYY-MM-DD;
- `status` — "scheduled" when the callback was recorded.

A receipt with status "scheduled" and an `account_event_id` means the callback now stands on the account history.
